pick.name: WIPO Madrid System
pick.what: One international application designating many countries, based on a home-office filing
pick.why: Cheapest way to extend one home filing (USPTO, EUIPO, UKIPO, etc.) to many countries; requires that home application first; base fee CHF 653 plus per-country fees
pick.free_limits: No free tier; use the WIPO fee calculator

alts.name: USPTO direct filing
alts.why: Largest commercial market; USD 350 per class base fee since 18 Jan 2025, plus surcharges for free-text goods (law-firm alerts)

alts.name: IP India self-file (classes 9 + 42)
alts.why: Rs 4,500 per class for individuals/startups/small enterprises, Rs 9,000 others; base for Madrid from India

candidates.name: WIPO Madrid
candidates.verdict: PICK to extend one home filing to many markets

candidates.name: USPTO
candidates.verdict: Best first filing if the US is the main market

candidates.name: EUIPO
candidates.verdict: One EU-wide filing; fee page blocked fetch (unverified)

candidates.name: Trademark attorney
candidates.verdict: Worth it for objections and oppositions

candidates.name: Class choice
candidates.verdict: Classes 9 (software) and 42 (SaaS) usually cover an AI product

decision: File first where your main market or home office is (USPTO for US, IP India for India, UKIPO for UK, EUIPO for EU), search the free databases first, then extend through WIPO Madrid when foreign markets matter. Hire an attorney only when an objection or opposition arrives. verify with a professional.
details: No free option: government filing fees apply in every jurisdiction; self-filing (IP India, USPTO) is the cheapest route.

region_notes.US: USD 350/class base fee; free-text goods descriptions add surcharges, so pick from the ID Manual.
region_notes.EU: EUIPO online filing: EUR 850 for one class, EUR 50 for the second, EUR 150 for each class from the third (fee schedule unchanged since 2016; confirm in the EUIPO fee calculator).
region_notes.UK: UKIPO online filing costs from GBP 205 per GOV.UK, more for additional classes. Verify current fees.
region_notes.India: Rs 4,500/class for small enterprises/startups vs Rs 9,000; Udyam registration helps. India's Madrid membership date not confirmed.

verify.note: Madrid cannot be the first filing: an international application must be based on a home (basic) application or registration, so the practical pick is 'home office filing, then Madrid'. Basic fee CHF 653 (b/w) not re-fetched (fees page lists only individual fees). Add that dependency to 'why'.
